sources.label: NYC Citywide Annualized Calendar Sales Update

method.baseline: Trailing 12-month average of recorded market sales (sale price > $10,000).
method.threshold: ±25% deviation (dominant of trailing-avg vs. YoY) flags a regime shift.
method.lag: Sales accrue for weeks after they occur; the latest 2 months are still filling in, so the latest complete month shown is May 2026.
method.note: Figures are computed facts from primary DOF sales records. Causal interpretation requires review.

narration.headline: Property sales in Staten Island fell to 249 in May 2026 — -34% vs. the trailing-12-month average. Signal: Cooling.
narration.citySummary: Citywide, 3,921 recorded market sales in May 2026 (median $940,000, total volume $8B), -11% vs. the trailing-12-month average and -15% year-over-year.
